item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena pours 200 cm³ of milk from a bottle into a tall glass. The milk takes the shape of the glass, but its volume stays 200 cm³.

Which statement explains this?

options.A: The particles in the milk are fixed in one position and cannot move at all.
options.B: The particles in the milk can move and change positions while staying close together because of the attraction between them.
options.C: The particles in the milk move freely in all directions and fill the whole glass.
options.D: The particles in the milk are far apart, so the milk can be squeezed into a smaller volume.
